title: Labeled-issue assignment rule
description: A labeled trigger issue arrives unbound: create the work with the rule's capability and ack the thread. The template of every derived `assign-rule-<provider>-<n>` definition; the per-provider AssignRules importer seeds one copy per config rule (baking the rule's capability, endpoint preference, target, team and actor into the create step). The copy — not this template — is what the arm defers to: enabling this template alone creates no scoped rule row, so the labeled-issue arm keeps its own path until a derived copy is live.
